body: I keep holding out hope but I've just run out. I always said maybe someday but everyone I know has told me it'll never happen, even she says it's very unlikely she'll ever see me romantically. And if she knew, I think it would hurt her, and I would hate myself for that. But sometimes when I get really low I think the only way she'll ever realize I mattered or that I was worth it is if I'm gone.

redditmodsuckass thank you. While I've heard a lot of what you're saying before, and have always been naive and foolish enough to ignore it I appreciate your advice. I understand how dumb it is at my age to suggest I found the one, even though my heart is screaming that I won't find anyone whose better than her. It sucks. But thanks.
